CDK Global Privacy Statement

CDK Global, Inc. and its affiliates (individually or collectively, “CDK”, “we”, “us” or “our”) recognize the importance of protecting the privacy of our customers and online visitors. This Privacy Statement discloses how we collect, use, disclose and store your information when you interact with us, including when you use the websites CDK owns and operates, such as https://www.cdkglobal.com/, https://www.cdkglobalheavytruck.com/, https://fortellis.io/, https://www.
